whatsNew: Departure has a new look. The purple is gone, and the app now uses cold slate and ice blue with bolder headings. The Arena is simpler. You can be on one team at a time, and the four modes sit in two rows: training and Skirmish against people on top, and Monster Ambush and Warpath against monsters below, from easier to harder. Monster Ambush fights now play out on screen, with your warrior and the monster clashing in every round. Skirmish shows only real teams, with a clear scoreboard and a picture of the two teams meeting. Making a battle scene after a Skirmish works again. Training Grounds now suggests one workout each day, picked from the area you have trained least. New players get a short full body workout with no weights. The Campfire is cleaner, with Overview, Roster and Chat at the top. Home and Train show more at a glance: today's challenge, your goal days, your streak and the XP you earned this week. The exercise picker lists the exercises you have done before first, with what you did last time. On the Equip board, boots now sit in their own tall frame.
note: Kyle checked build 45 in TestFlight and asked to release it (2026-11-26). Holds qualia-fitness PRs 22 to 31 and the Glacier look (PR 29).
